title: Perovskite quantum dot-based gas sensors for environmental monitoring: mechanisms, materials, and perspectives on next-generation pollution control
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47476-47505

This is the first comprehensive review that systematically analyzes gas sensing technologies based on PQDs, with a particular emphasis on their relevance to environmental monitoring and pollution control.
